rows.text: In the investiture address of 7 May 2022 reproduced on the page, the speaker says: 'Oui, le peuple français n'a pas prolongé le mandat qui s'achève, commencé le 14 mai 2017.'

locator.item: 'Discours du Président de la République lors de la Cérémonie d'investiture' card dated '7 mai 2022', paragraph beginning 'Oui, le peuple français'

rows.text: The Élysée reports that 'Emmanuel Macron a été officiellement investi Président de la République, pour un second mandat ce samedi 7 mai', in a ceremony held in the salle des fêtes of the Élysée Palace 'à 11 heures'.

locator.item: article body, first and second sentences

rows.text: It states that Laurent Fabius, President of the Constitutional Council, 'a proclamé officiellement les résultats du scrutin du 24 avril', and that the Grand Chancellor of the Legion of Honour then handed the head of State the grand master's insignia.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff). Election rounds, the Constitutional Council's proclamation, its publication, the investiture ceremony, a stated start of term, an outer limit and any stated end stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
